items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I later worked with him for a spell

ctx.x: The trombone section was Jimmy Cleveland, Buster Cooper and Al -- oh, I'm sorry, I can't think of that trombone player's name (Hayes). And the rhythm section -- the reed section was Bobby Plater, he was beautiful, Bobby Plater; Morris Lane, Clifford Solomon, Oscar Estelle, the baritone, and...who else am I missing? It's been a lot of years and I keep...I've got up to the date in my mind.

Anyhow, the rhythm section was Elmer Gill, piano player, and I later worked with him for a spell, and after Elmer, me playing bass and William Mackell playing guitar. And after Elmer, Hamp went without piano. The band...
